page_title: PAL 0-1 CEL | Las Palmas v Celta Vigo 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
90+2' Here is a change. Oscar Mingueza is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' What a miss! Viti (Las Palmas) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
88' One of the players from Las Palmas times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Vicente Guaita.
85' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dinko Horkas, who smothers the ball.
82' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) coming on for Hugo Alvarez.
79' The referee points to the corner flag and Las Palmas will take a corner.
79' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Vicente Guaita to dive and make a save.
75' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Jose Campana (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Alex Suarez.
74' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
70' Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' Corner kick. Las Palmas will have an opportunity.
67' It is time for a substitution. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is on for Fabio Silva.
67' Substitution. Oliver McBurnie walks off the pitch and Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
63' Las Palmas control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
62' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) replaces Borja Iglesias.
62' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Williot Swedberg will be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
61' That will be all from Javier Manquillo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
59' Las Palmas win a corner.
59' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
58' Luis Carrion has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) replacing Alex Munoz.
58' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Javier Munoz.

56' Yet another yellow card and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Adrian Cordero Vega doesn't allow any discussions.
55' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
54' The referee shows a yellow card to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
54' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
52' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
50' Las Palmas force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' Two players stand over the free kick. Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
49' Las Palmas get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Adrian Cordero Vega shows a yellow card to Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
43' Vicente Guaita steps in and intercepts a long pass from Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas).
42' Yellow card. Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
41' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Vicente Guaita is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
41' The ball is cleared after Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
40' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
35' Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
32' Fouls committed – 0:3.
32' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

28' 0 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
22' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Celta Vigo due to an offside in the build-up play.
19' Wait! Referee Adrian Cordero Vega has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
17' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way low into the back of the net, bouncing in off the right post.
17' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post.
15' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Las Palmas force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

8' Excellent touch by Fabio Silva (Las Palmas)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.

7' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
5' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) gets a yellow card.
5' A yellow card is awarded to Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
4' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero Vega is the one to supervise the game today.
